jobs.how: Write the speed reference and the run/stop command, then confirm the drive is running, at reference and under bus control. Writes to these objects restart the 8-03 control timeout.

points.use: Read: shows if the drive is in Hand

jobs.how: Trend actual speed, frequency, motor current and power for proof of operation and energy. The kWh and hour counters are read-only values from the drive.
Use OK/FAULT as the summary alarm, the warning, trip and triplock bits to tell them apart, and the alarm and warning words for detail when troubleshooting.
Write the fault reset to clear a tripped drive. The kWh and running hours counters each have their own reset object.

jobs.job: PID setpoint and feedback from the BMS
jobs.how: When the drive runs its own PID loop, the BMS can write the setpoint to Setpoint 1 and the feedback to Bus feedback 1. Writing bus feedback also restarts the control timeout.

points.use: Read: feedback in its configured unit

jobs.how: Read the fault count and the logged fault number, subcode, time, date and the drive values recorded at the fault. The fault index object is writable.

points.use: Write: fault index for the fault log
Read: current at the time of the fault
Read: speed at the time of the fault

jobs.how: The drive's own analog and digital inputs and relays are exposed directly; option-card I/O only responds when that MCB card is fitted. Custom AV 102-131 stay blank until parameter 8-77 maps them.

points.use: Write: terminal 42 output under bus control, %
Read/write: custom object once mapped in 8-77

checklist: Set a unique device instance in parameter 8-70 (factory 1), noting the MCA 125 DIP switches override it unless they are all On or all Off.
Set the IP address with 12-00 (Manual, DHCP or BOOTP) and 12-01 to 12-03 for manual, then power cycle; the UDP port is 12-72 (factory 47808).
Connect the drive to only one BACnet network, since the MCA 125 shares the 8-7* parameters with the built-in MS/TP port, and check 12-78 for a duplicate instance.
Check the drive programming guide for the control site, control word and reference source settings needed for bus control, since the MCA 125 guide does not list them.
Set 8-03 Control Timeout Time and 8-04 Control Timeout Function, and have the BMS write about 3 times per timeout window.
Verify reads of BV 6 (HAND/AUTO reference), BV 32 (Bus control), AV 0 (Speed act value) and BV 5 (OK/FAULT monitor).
Write AV 1 (Input reference 1), command BV 1 (RUN/STOP command) to run, and confirm BV 4 (RUN/STOP monitor) and AV 0 follow, then stop it.
Map BV 5, BV 22 (Trip), BV 23 (Triplock) and AV 61 (Alarm word 1) as alarms and test BV 3 (Fault reset command) on a trip.
